Permanent eyeliner adds soft, lasting definition along your lash line, so your eyes look bright and awake the moment you get up.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, classic top eyeliner is applied as a clean, natural line that suits every eye shape. Unlike pencil or gel liner, it will not smudge, run, or fade by midday, which makes it perfect for dark early mornings, the gym, and days that start before the sun does. The pigment is placed with precision and refined during your included follow up session.

Tired of reapplying eyeliner that never lasts the whole day? Book your permanent eyeliner appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

Microshading combines fine strokes with soft shading to create brows that are structured and defined yet still natural.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, microshading is a great middle ground between crisp hair strokes and a full powdered look. It suits clients who want more definition than microblading alone but a softer finish than solid shading, and it wears well on combination and oily skin. Results last 1 to 3 years with an included touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Want brows with both structure and softness heading into the holidays? Book your microshading session at adrianaspmu.com.

Adriana's Permanent Makeup serves clients from Salem and across Southern New Hampshire, all from one trusted studio.

Located in Salem, NH, the studio draws clients from Windham, Derry, Methuen, Haverhill, and Lawrence who want natural brows, lips, and eyeliner close to home. With over 20 years of experience and more than 5,000 procedures performed, master artist Adriana Santos delivers the same careful, personalized work to every client, whether they drive in from just up Route 28 or a neighboring town.

Looking for a skilled permanent makeup artist near Salem this fall? Book your appointment at adrianaspmu.com and see why clients travel to this studio.

Dark lip neutralization is a permanent makeup technique that balances naturally dark or uneven lip tones for a smoother, fresher base.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, this treatment gently corrects hyperpigmentation before or alongside lip blush, so color looks even and true. It is a thoughtful option for clients whose lips carry cooler or darker pigment and who want a soft, natural result. Like other lip work, it is customized to your tone and refined during an included follow up session.

Have darker lip tones kept you from trying lip color? Book your lip consultation at adrianaspmu.com and see what neutralization can do.

Nano brows are an excellent choice for oily skin, because their ultra fine machine strokes hold up better than manual techniques.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, nano brows deposit crisp, hair like strokes using a digital device, creating brows that look natural across all skin types. On oily skin, where microblading can soften and fade sooner, nano brows keep their definition longer. Each set is customized to your face, and results last 1 to 3 years with an included touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Has oily skin made you nervous about brow tattooing? Book a nano brows consultation at adrianaspmu.com and ask about your skin type.

Permanent eyeliner near Salem is an easy visit to Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, for eyes that look defined every day.

Whether you choose a classic line, a cat eye, or a soft smokey effect, permanent eyeliner replaces daily pencil and liquid liner with pigment that lasts. Clients from Salem, Windham, Derry, and across Southern New Hampshire choose it for definition that survives workouts, cold wind, and busy mornings. The look is refined during your included follow up session.

Ready to wake up with your eyeliner already done? Book your permanent eyeliner appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

Permanent makeup belongs to everyone, and at Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, that belief shapes every appointment.

Flawless brows, softly tinted lips, and defined eyes are not about changing who you are. They are about waking up as the most polished version of yourself, even on a dark October morning. Our studio is proudly women owned and welcoming to clients of every background, identity, and skin tone. With over 20 years of experience and more than 5,000 procedures performed, master artist Adriana Santos tailors every result to your natural features.

Have you been waiting for a studio that treats your beauty as uniquely yours? Book your appointment at adrianaspmu.com and take the first step toward effortless, natural results.

Powder brows create a soft, shaded finish that looks like a lightly filled in brow, defined yet still natural.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, powder brows (also called ombre shading) are applied with a machine that builds a gentle gradient, lighter at the front and deeper toward the tail. They suit most skin types, including oily skin where hair stroke techniques can fade faster, and they are a favorite for anyone who fills in their brows daily. Results typically last 1 to 3 years with a touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Would you like to retire your brow pencil before the holidays? Book your powder brows session at adrianaspmu.com.

Lip blush is a permanent makeup technique that adds soft, natural color and definition to your lips, so you can skip daily lipstick.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, lip blush deposits gentle pigment to even out tone and enhance your natural lip shape. It is ideal for lips that look pale, uneven, or faded, and the color stays put through hot coffee, cold New England mornings, and every scarf you pull over your face. Results typically last 1 to 3 years, with an included touch up 4 to 8 weeks after your first session to perfect the tone.

Would you love to wake up with a soft flush of color already in place? Book your lip blush appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

Every great permanent makeup result starts with a consultation, where your features, goals, and skin type guide the plan.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, master artist Adriana Santos maps your brow shape, studies your natural tone, and talks through your routine before recommending a technique. This is how results end up looking natural and personal rather than one size fits all. Serving Salem and Southern New Hampshire, the studio treats every face as individual.

Planning ahead for the holidays? Brows need about four weeks to heal, so October is the right time. Book your consultation at adrianaspmu.com.

Microblading and nano brows both create natural hair like brows, but they use different tools and suit different skin types.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, microblading uses a fine manual blade for soft, delicate strokes, while nano brows use a digital machine to deposit ultra fine strokes that hold up well on oily skin. Both are customized to your face shape and last 1 to 3 years with a follow up at 4 to 8 weeks. During your consultation, master artist Adriana Santos helps you choose the technique that fits your skin and lifestyle.

Not sure which brow technique is right for you? Book a consultation at adrianaspmu.com and find your best match.

A permanent cat eye gives you a lifted, defined winged liner that stays sharp all day, with no unsteady hand required.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, the top eyeliner cat eye extends your lash line into a clean, flattering wing shaped to your eye. It is ideal if you love a polished, editorial look but never quite get both sides even with liquid liner. The pigment lasts through long days, workouts, and every holiday party on your calendar, and it is refined during your included follow up.

Ever wish your winged liner looked this even every single morning? Book your cat eye eyeliner appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

Existing permanent makeup from another artist can often be refreshed or corrected, once it is evaluated by a skilled artist.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, older or uneven work is reviewed carefully, since previous pigment affects what is possible. Clients are asked to share a clear photo in natural light before booking so the right approach can be planned. From there, master artist Adriana Santos recommends a touch up or a correction that works with what is already there.

A new season is a good moment to reset brows that faded over the summer. Book an evaluation at adrianaspmu.com.

Looking for microblading near Salem? Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH is an easy drive for natural, hair like brows.

Microblading here is fully customized, with delicate manual strokes mapped to your brow shape and skin tone for a soft, realistic finish. With over 20 years of experience and more than 5,000 procedures performed, the studio is a trusted choice for clients across Southern New Hampshire, including Windham, Derry, and nearby Haverhill. Microblading typically lasts 1 to 3 years with an included touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Ready to trade your brow pencil for effortless brows? Book your microblading appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

You can refresh your brows and lips in a single visit with the eyebrows and lips combo at Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH.

Combining brow work and lip blush in one session saves time and gives you a fully polished result that heals together. It is one of the most popular choices for clients who want a complete refresh before family photos and end of year events, and each service is still fully customized to your features. Let the studio know in advance so enough time is reserved for you.

Would you rather transform your whole look in one appointment? Book the brows and lips combo at adrianaspmu.com.

Microblading heals over about four weeks, and following simple aftercare is what makes the results look their best.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Salem, NH, brows go through a natural process of light scabbing, lightening, and settling before the true color appears. Keeping the area clean and dry protects your investment, and cooler fall weather makes that far easier than midsummer. A follow up session 4 to 8 weeks later perfects any spots that healed lighter, which is a normal part of the process.

Curious what to expect while your brows heal? Book your microblading consultation at adrianaspmu.com and get every detail up front.
